设计意图： Long-cycle advances led by overnight repricing can reflect gradual incorporation of information outside continuous trading, whereas gains that are repeatedly surrendered intraday can indicate a less durable phase. This factor separates the long-horizon return source into overnight and intraday components and scales their difference by realized return activity, yielding a bounded measure of informa

因子路由 / 公式 ⚠ FE DSL 暂不支持

[ts_sum(63, overnight_return) - ts_sum(63, intraday_return)] / ts_sum(63, |overnight_return| + |intraday_return|)
依赖列: open, close

  15. 步骤15：abs(v14(divide)) → 计算绝对值
  16. 步骤16：col('AdjClose') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）

  26. 步骤26：col('AdjClose') → 取指定列字段（如 col('close') → 收盘价序列）

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 overnight_cumulative：overnight_ret.滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).sum()
  2. 计算 intraday_cumulative：intraday_ret.滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).sum()
  3. 计算 total_activity：(overnight_ret.abs() + intraday_ret.abs()).滚动窗口(63, min_periods=63).sum()
  4. 计算 phase_leadership：(overnight_cumulative - intraday_cumulative) / total_activity

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_overnight_repricing_phase_leadership(df): """Identifies long-horizon trends led by overnight repricing rather than intraday reversal.""" df_copy = df.copy() overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"]) overnight_cumulative = overnight_ret.rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum() intraday_cumulative = intraday_ret.rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum() total_activity = (overnight_ret.abs() + intraday_ret.abs()).rolling(63, min_periods=63).sum().replace(0.0, np.nan) phase_leadership = (overnight_cumulative - intraday_cumulative) / total_activity df_copy["factor_overnight_repricing_phase_leadership"] = phase_leadership "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["factor_overnight_repricing_phase_leadership"]
